description: The image presents two nested pie charts, or sunburst diagrams, comparing the clustering statistics for "AttentionInfluence" on the left and "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" on the right. Neither chart includes a standalone legend; instead, category labels and numerical values—which sum to 100 in the inner rings, indicating percentages—are placed directly inside the slices or connected via pointing arrows. Both charts are visually emphasized using an exploded format, where all slices are slightly separated by white space. The segments are grouped by color into an inner ring of broad categories and an outer ring of subcategories, though they do not appear to be ordered by strictly descending size. The left chart contains 22 total slices (6 inner and 16 outer). Its inner ring features mint green Education 25, orange History & Society 23, light blue Health & Medicine 22, pink-red Science 15, brown Tech & Engineer 12, and cyan Fin & Law 3. Its corresponding outer ring contains mint green Teaching & resources 15 and Science & technology education 10; light blue Diseases 11, Medical 6, and Nutrition 5; orange Society & culture 10, Historical review 7, and Events & people 6; pink-red Animal & Plant 13 and Materials 2; brown Infor tech 5, Emerging tech 4, and Materials 3; and cyan Manage 2 and Policy 1. The right chart contains 21 total slices (6 inner and 15 outer). The inner ring consists of mint green Education 38, light blue Health & Medicine 19, orange History & Society 19, pink-red Science 15, brown Tech & Engineer 8, and a small cyan slice labeled with an ellipsis (...). Its outer ring includes mint green Science & technology education 19, Teaching & resources 17, and Healthy education 2; light blue Diseases 10, Nutrition 7, and Medical 2; orange Historical review 12, Society & culture 5, and Events & people 2; pink-red Animal & Plant 12 and Materials 3; brown Emerging tech 4, Infor tech 3, and Materials 1; and a single cyan slice for Manage 1.
